name: PARK24 Co., Ltd.
summary: PARK24 Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages parking lots in Japan, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Parking Business Japan, Parking Business International, and Mobility Business. The company offers hourly parking facilities; reserved and monthly parking; parking facilities for non-passenger vehicles, including large vehicles, motorcycles, and bicycles; and overseas parking facilities, such as patrolled parking facilities, and pay and display parking services.
